reference_sql:
WITH week_sales AS (
  -- one row per order line sold from 7 to 13 April 2025 (UTC days): only the columns the total needs
  SELECT parent_category, units
  FROM sales
  WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-07' AND DATE '2025-04-13'
)
SELECT parent_category, SUM(units) AS units
FROM week_sales
GROUP BY parent_category
